note: Literature confirms distinct SPAX11 phenotypes: C-terminal inherited p.Glu415Lys shows slight or absent cerebellar atrophy, whereas de novo missense variants display severe cerebellar atrophy with demonstrated microtubule disruption.

evidence.text: Cultured fibroblasts from patients harboring distinct TUBA4A missense variants showed significant alterations in microtubule organization and dynamics, with de novo cases manifesting severe cerebellar atrophy.
